notes_for_editor: Thin record. The FFLA and Eastern lists give only name, county and status; two web searches and about six page reads found no build date, builder, staffing or removal record for a Poor Mountain lookout. The distance of about 3.2 km between the FFLA point and the Wikipedia summit is our calculation from the two coordinate pairs; it is not in any source. The DCR preserve page says Roanoke County, while the lookout lists say Montgomery County; the mountain may straddle the line, but no source here says so. No NHLR or FFLOS page for this tower exists in the local crawl cache. Next steps if someone wants more: Virginia Department of Forestry records, and Roanoke or Montgomery County newspaper archives.
